description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost.
Kykar triggers, exiling Scholar of the Ages.
Resolve Walk the Aeons, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Kykar triggers, returning Scholar of the Ages from exile to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
